title: Fix halo around pasted/restored regions
description: Investigate mask feather/dilation, colorspace/range mismatch, resize interpolation; match LADA paste/blend behavior.

title: Eliminate YOLO CPU hop
description: Move letterbox/preprocess to torch on GPU/XPU; keep frames and YOLO outputs on-device (no CPU uint8/NumPy).

title: Fix remux/mux timestamps (Duration N/A)
description: Ensure output container has valid duration/PTS/DTS; handle VFR; verify via ffprobe frame pkt_pts_time/pkt_duration_time.

title: Early passthrough when no detections
description: If det=0 and no active scenes, encode original frame immediately to save memory/latency.

title: Tiled detection for 4K+ sources
description: Add overlapping tiling path for YOLO; merge boxes/masks on-device.

title: GPU mask postproc (dilate/feather/gain)
description: Implement dilation/feathering/gain entirely on-device (CUDA/XPU); unify with compositor.

title: ROI-cropped restoration to save compute
description: Optionally crop to ROI bbox (+context), run restorer, paste back; preserve temporal window semantics.

title: Dynamic imgsz by input resolution
description: Auto imgsz heuristic (e.g., 640 for 1080p, 960 for higher); expose override.

title: Investigate intermittent missed ROI detections
description: Compare padding/letterbox parity, conf threshold, imgsz, fp16 precision, dilation/union; add logging to isolate frames.

title: Control ROI unions vs per-box
description: Add option to control union/merge strategy and measure impact on quality/speed.

title: NVDEC prefetch N/N+1 (2-batch)
description: Decode next batch while current batch runs detect+restore to reduce GPU idle gaps.

title: Custom ffmpeg decoder/encoder args
description: Allow user-specified ffmpeg input and output options (ordered correctly) and surface stderr on fallback.

title: Better timing + print around remux
description: Add prints around remux and per-stage timing summary; keep wall clock vs perf_counter.

title: Parallel SBS processing
description: Explore running left/right eye restoration concurrently (threads/streams) while keeping ordering stable.

title: VR pre-projection options for detection
description: Optional fisheye/v360 transforms to improve detection on edge/trapezoid VR cases (yaw/pitch/fov).

title: Inference-only model graph port
description: Port/verify inference-only graph (TSA/PCD/residual) and ensure weight loading works.

title: Startup banner: file version + config echo
description: Print build/version hash and resolved config at start to avoid stale file confusion.

title: Progress indicators
description: Add progress bars / throughput readout; keep lightweight for CLI.

title: Inference-Letterbox
description: Keep mask postproc + compositor ops on-device (replace cv2/np in mask_utils/image_utils hot path).

title: Standardize env-var debug controls
description: Keep and standardize env-var driven debug hooks (GR_DEBUG, GR_DUMP_ONE_FRAME, GR_DUMP_DIR, GR_DUMP_MASKS, GR_DUMP_ROI_INDEX, optional GR_DUMP_EVERY_N). Ensure default-off, throttled logging, no per-frame disk I/O unless enabled, and avoid GPU sync unless dumping.
sources: Halo investigation; mask/alpha/overlay dumps; SBS tile-pad debugging
